# kashida

> Catch the Arabic-typography mistakes that break Arabic rendering — but only where Arabic is actually present.

kashida (formerly arabitype) is a CLI + MCP server (part of Otto, dev.ottospace.co) that flags the
Arabic-typography errors AI codegen and Latin-default styling produce: letter-spacing / Tailwind
tracking on Arabic (shatters ligatures), tight line-height (crushes tashkeel), tiny sizes,
text-transform: uppercase (meaningless on Arabic), and Latin-only font stacks. Every check is gated
on an Arabic signal — Arabic-script codepoints, lang="ar"/dir="rtl" ancestry, or an .arabic/[lang=ar]
selector — so a pure-Latin file reports zero issues. Detection is parser-verified (Babel for
JS/TS/JSX/TSX, PostCSS for CSS): it reads cn()/clsx()/cva()/template-literal class composition,
inline JSX style objects, and arbitrary Tailwind values (text-[13px], leading-[1.2], tracking-[0.1em]).
It reports only — it never edits, because typography is judgment.

## Use it
- CLI: `npx github:moradothmanepro-OTTO/kashida .`
- MCP: run `kashida-mcp` (tools: kashida_scan, kashida_check_code)
- AI rules: `kashida --init-rules` writes ARABIC-TYPE-RULES.md

## Rules for agents
No letter-spacing/tracking on Arabic; line-height ≥ 1.5; body Arabic ≥ 16px; no uppercase on
Arabic; use an Arabic font with a fallback (Cairo / IBM Plex Sans Arabic).

Links: https://github.com/moradothmanepro-OTTO/kashida · https://dev.ottospace.co
